verdict.rationale: The firm's own Emerging Growth Companies & VC page lists angel and seed financings, venture capital financings, and private equity investments, and says it prepares and negotiates equity issuance documentation. The Executive Compensation page adds representation of founders in early- and late-stage financings, so the stage range from seed to late stage is covered. However, the pages give no deal volume, deal counts, or representative transactions, and never explicitly name priced rounds (e.g., Series A/B). Missing for 10: stated deal volume or representative transactions, explicit priced-round/series terminology, independent corroboration.
